                  Mark the nozzle-to-part gap

                  Mark the head edge, the print directly below it, and a stationary feature on the printer frame. Use a healthy close-contact view.

                  Select the nozzle tip.

                  Checks compare repeated views near this nozzle position to reduce perspective changes. If the nozzle is hidden or the part edge changes shape, mark a new reference. Start a fresh reference for each print.
